results.title: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces strike Tor-M2 missile system and seven radars in Russia's Krasnodar Krai – video
results.description: Ukrainian troops have struck a Tor-M2 surface-to-air missile and seven radar stations in Russia, including near Yeysk and Primorsko-Akhtarsk.

results.title: `Youth must stay away from drugs to build Viksit Bharat`: PM Modi launches nationwide anti-drug campaign
results.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyaan, urging young people to stay away from drugs and lead India's journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047.
